summary: Plan-only readiness for RM1.34-B-PATCH-A (canonical element token migration darkness->dark) and RM1.34-B-PATCH-B (tides faction decision). NO source mutation is performed in this task. NO baseline v6 is generated. The plan enumerates the surgical edits, audit re-runs, balance review steps, rollback procedure, and the explicit dependency on operator sign-off before any future task may execute the patches.

patches.title: Canonical element token migration: darkness -> dark
patches.scope: Single-file controlled rewrite of boss_family_element_faction_matrix_v1.json replacing every standalone 'darkness' element token with 'dark' across `elements_included` and `boss_families[].element_resistances`. NO faction touched.
surgical_edits: For every boss_families[].element_resistances key 'darkness', rename to 'dark' preserving the numeric value.
Update metadata `task_origin` to 'RM1.34-B-PATCH-A' and append a `patch_history` array entry.
validators_to_rerun: all boss_systems validators (matrix structure, enrage policy, cross-table audit)
rollback_procedure: git revert of the single JSON file

patches.title: Tides faction decision (mint OR strike)
patches.scope: Decide whether 'tides' becomes a live faction (mint at least one tides hero in roster + bible) OR is struck from boss_family_element_faction_matrix_v1.json. EITHER branch resolves the orphan.

branches.description: Mint at least one live tides hero (id tides_*) in /api/heroes and character_bible. Hero must be 5-star or below, no Borea-style hidden flag.
Strike 'tides' from boss_family_element_faction_matrix_v1.json (remove from faction_groups_included and all boss_families[].faction_resistances).
prerequisites: confirm no future seasonal content depends on tides as a separate faction

rollback_procedure: git revert of touched files (hero/character_bible OR matrix)
re-anchor baseline to v5 or prior
prerequisites: operator decision on branch (MINT vs STRIKE)

baseline_v6_creation_blocked_until: both RM1.34-B-PATCH-A and RM1.34-B-PATCH-B executed and validated
SAFETY-ROLLUP-A go_no_go_decision moves from NO_GO to candidate-GO
